scope: Synthetic rational laws only; no learned policy or evaluation data read.

statement.sharpness: The floor-aware frontier is the closure of gaps achieved by unique row and exposure optima of fixed m-label classifiers with whole-example abstention, any fixed 0<r<1, and 0<=c0<1; m>=2 integer. Interior points with positive common mass attain it exactly.

two_atom_no_reversal.qualification: A fixed two-atom positive-weight feature support is an additional counterexample to a proposed universal iff based only on nonconstant w.
